question: When an empty plastic bottle with an airtight stopper is pushed deeper into a bucket of water, the increasing upward force that resists the downward push is known as __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**buoyant force (or upthrust)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **Buoyant force**, also known as **upthrust**, is the upward force exerted by a fluid on an object immersed in it. This force opposes the downward gravitational pull.

• When an **empty plastic bottle with an airtight stopper** is pushed deeper into water, the volume of displaced water increases, leading to a stronger buoyant force.

• The buoyant force increases with depth due to the greater pressure exerted by the surrounding water. This is governed by the principle of fluid pressure increasing with depth.
